svg.text: Ring closes back to the master's 2nd port (cable-break tolerance). 28 slaves; ~0.1 ms frame at 1 kHz. Each joint drive also carries two hard-wired STO lines from the safety relay (not shown).

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hands: 10 micro-motor channels per hand on one EtherCAT slave (F28P65x). Wrist linear actuators driven by the hand controller.
